description: Whitewater builds on Canoeing or Kayaking for moving water: hazards and cold-water injuries, reading river features and difficulty ratings, strokes, ferries and eddy turns, river signals and safety gear, self-rescue and throw-rope rescues, and planning a whitewater trip.

safety.note: Whitewater paddling requires a qualified instructor, Safety Afloat, and the appropriate prerequisite badge.

outlineNote: The official page lists twelve requirements, but the excerpt grouped them by topic, so no requirement outline is published yet. Canoeing or Kayaking must be earned first.
